author: Krozz_08
body:
(a bit late)

Your build and skills look good, but carman scroll are better for the negative effects and maybe change some spells. Definitely unlock magus, you'll get a magic buff and abilitys that hit all the enemies (good for horde mode dungeons)

You can buy arcane slime, it hits really hard in t7 and you can use it in t8 if you want it.

Now I'd like to know how you're doing with dungeons? Are you doing well in horde mode? Not bosses obviously. 

I have a tip for doing horde dungeons. T6, not t7 cause in t7 you can't do so well the horde dungeons. But you can complete a dungeon entirely in T6 mode. You would need a new follower, new armor, spells, and staff, maybe 2 staffs or 1 staff and scroll or shield. I gave this tip to a friend and he completed quite a few dungeons as a Tier 7 and farmed a lot of orns easily

author: Subject-Ad9102
body:
Gear looks solid, spell choice is good, that's the same route I was taking before switching to attuner at T7

Tips:
-Get Magus, you'll get a instant DMG boost as well as very useful AOE spells for horde dungeons, far better than berserker for archdruid no doubt
-Stay away from upgrading gear until you feel yourself hit a wall, I'd stick to using whetstones and pure whetstones, on new equip as you most likely won't stick with a T7 weapon upon hitting next tier (and you hit new tiers quicker lower level, this conserves resources for better gear in the future, especially if you'll be switching to better items upon hitting a new tier, don't masterforge or demonforge until T8 at minimum, this is a big resource waster earlier on)
-as far as leveling goes, raids can be good, if you have friends who play you can do world raids together and DMG is split equally no matter how much you actually do to the boss, meaning equal rewards no matter contribution, as far as kingdom raids at T7, Last Titan, Surtr (while event runs), and Starlord are going to be the main ones to keep running for xp, the other top options for xp would be monuments, boss-horde dungeons (horde once you get magus, spam wildfire II and you'll be fine, don't run horde without AOE at low level, you'll burn keys when you die, an AOE pet would work as well for added safety) another huge thing is world farming stops becoming useful after around T5, so when traveling hit event mobs only as far as world monsters go (for event xp, and other exotics you may not find after event is gone), target dungeons when traveling and add to activity list to play once home
-stay away from anguish until at least T9, it makes the game far more difficult for minimal boosts to rewards early on, this is a endgame building for minmaxxing rewards, don't use it as a means to boost rewards early on (do start anguish as soon as unlocked just keep levels at 0 until later on, world anguish can generally be set to high as you want with minimal issues for proof farming early as a means to get more demonworking tools or anguish crucibles)
-same above applies to alter of ascension, ignore this building until T10, many many resources are required for very minimal stat improvements, this is another minmaxxing endgame building that shouldn't be touched until T10
-Also take note of what your T10 class will be upon finishing your current line as you'll most likely be sticking to it for a while until you can get solid gear for other classes (yours is heretic on your current line, flask/high magic DMG play style, not as versatile as other options but a great class nonetheless, want something more versatile? Switch attuner after finding and completing horus summoner play style, very fragile, but very consistent in dungeons and towers. Want something close to heretic but more versatile? Switch to gods once your able to, to get deity, high magic DMG play style/much better for dungeons, towers, world content, each class is very different from one another so be alert when you get the option to direct to different path and think it over) 
-Arcanists, when you see these buildings if there's a new spell, you should most likely buy it, unless it'll make you broke ofc, but there really isn't a reason not to

Hopefully these can help you out a bit 👍

author: No_Window4324
body:
Since u are lvl150+, the thing u should do, is look for having all the classes avaible, if u can, ask people on ur region, country,etc, if they have near their Nexus, the NPC "Horus" , he gives u like 3 quest, to find some specific Atunner equipments, and then he unlocks u the Class Atunner/Summoner, that IMO is a Must, for soloing fast assaults alone, u are rly squishy, but ur summons grow too much above the dmg u deal on early lvls, in my personal experience, i did like 300k on my best build+Buffs+Debuffs on target, using T8 Necromancer, that was using Lotan debuff for Dragon Sickness for charging up mana flask with multi-flare, and using Fulmination with Lightining sigil and repeat with those flask, but man that set up takes long amount of turns, and the dmg output is so lame... i even went for Cronomancer, for Stasis Debuff, the last year, when i started Stasis was able to interrupt 100% of times, and had 20% chance to be lost, so 1/5 chance to get debuffed, but 100% sure, that it wont atk me while im making the set up... now is 90% chance not to move, and 10% chance to get lost, lower chance to get lost, but that 90% feels unsafe when u facing a oneshot type assault...

But on Summoner, ur summons deal like 40k each, even on ☆7, u just need equipment with "Summons stats+...%" in my case if the Assault is one target type i go Summoner, if is multi target type, i go Deity, well im already on 10☆, but if i got here, it was for Summoner for sure
